trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.tip: Earn every other trophy in the base game. It pops automatically once the other 54 are yours — no online play needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.tip: The opening mission. Unmissable — it pops as you play through the start of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.tip: Unmissable. Finish the first chapter of the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.tip: Unmissable. Finish the second chapter of the story. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens up after Breakfast Run in this chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.tip: Unmissable. Finish the third chapter of the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.tip: Unmissable. Finish the fourth chapter of the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.tip: Unmissable. Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.tip: Story mission in Chapter 2. Unmissable — switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.tip: Story mission. Unmissable — it pops when the heist is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.tip: Story mission. Unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.tip: Story mission. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.tip: Story mission at Vice City International Airport. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.tip: Story mission. Unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.tip: The hardest trophy and the longest grind (~200 hours to Platinum overall). Check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story — earlier progress counts. You only need selected portions: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 animals studied, 42 Shooting Range golds, 42 Drone Time Trials, 300 stunts and 70 of 80 Challenges.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.tip: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.tip: Sample all nine activity types at least once — fishing, hunting, racing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, shooting range and drone races.

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.tip: All 42 Shooting Range gold medals across the two ranges. Also required for 100% completion, so it is not optional.

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.tip: Win at least one drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations. The 42 Drone Time Trials are also needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.tip: Win 20 unique races. 100% completion needs 30 of 40 races won, so this pops on the way.

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.tip: Take on Cal's fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing is introduced through optional missions — do it when it appears.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.tip: Complete any one of the four in-game arcade games. Quick and easy — grab it early.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.tip: Finish Andy's Strangers & Freaks questline through to his final mission.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.tip: Finish Kenton's questline through to his final mission. Kenton's treasure sets also feed 100% completion (5 of 7 needed).

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.tip: Finish Billy's questline through to his final mission.

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.tip: Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count here. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One Chapter 3 race (Race Against Yago) is time-sensitive, so save first, then race.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.tip: Finish Randy's questline through to his final mission.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.tip: Finish Tyrone's questline through to his final mission.

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.tip: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia — each outdoor spot should count twice if you bring your partner. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.tip: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. All 15 of Bret's Target Decks are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.tip: Complete any 3 full collectible card sets. 100% completion needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past this one.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.tip: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Scan unfamiliar vehicles and landmarks from the very start — 200 base-model vehicles are also needed for 100%.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.tip: Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges. 100% needs 70 of 80, and many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.tip: Escape a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you. Bank vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away, so this pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal — but the trophy only pops once you have fully left the red heat zone.

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.tip: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.tip: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.tip: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.tip: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away; the trophy is delayed. Save first, the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.tip: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.tip: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies. Use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.tip: Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. 100% needs all eight vaults.

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.tip: Rob an armored truck and escape. It only pops once you have fully left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.tip: Uncover the complete map by exploring every region of Leonida. It fills in naturally as you travel for other trophies.

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.tip: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.tip: Enjoy a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach. A quiet, easy one — do it when you are passing through Vice Beach.

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.tip: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community — try driving straight out through the glass in a showroom.

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.tip: Rob Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley (an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2). Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe contents (blow it open with a Sticky Bomb) — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.tip: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.tip: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.tip: Hidden trophy — the exact unlock method is still unconfirmed by the community. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, so keep playing and check back; this guide will be updated as it is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.tip: Hidden trophy — the exact unlock method is still unconfirmed by the community. The description suggests a strange, unexpected encounter somewhere in Leonida; check back for a confirmed method.

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.tip: Perform a melee drive-by elimination. The precise method is still being confirmed — try a melee attack from a moving vehicle against a target.

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.tip: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs. The total is cumulative, and the same $250,000 counts toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.tip: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops — cumulative across every kind of shop, so it builds up naturally as you buy gear, clothes and garages.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.tip: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.tip: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
